title: solid-lean
summary: The tower theory H is the many-sorted first-order theory of a tower of ZFC universes Z_0, Z_1, ... cut at consecutive inaccessible cardinals, with transition maps j_n identifying Z_n with the rank segment V(kappa_n) of Z_{n+1}. H is solid in Enayat's sense. For models M, N, P, with N interpreted in M and P interpreted in N, and an M-definable isomorphism between M and P, there is an M-definable isomorphism between M and N. The registered statement (Palomar/Challenge.lean) writes out the many-sorted first-order logic of H from scratch, with structures, formulas, satisfaction and definability…

review.reason: Formalization of a solidity result for a tower theory of ZFC universes.
